cases.title: Edges across and onto groups
cases.note: An edge that ends on a group should not land where another edge passes through its border.
cases.source:
flowchart TD
  subgraph one [Group one]
    a1 --> a2
    a1 --> a3
  end
  subgraph two [Group two]
    b1 --> b2
  end
  a2 --> b1
  a3 --> b1
  b2 --> a1
  c --> one
  c --> two
  one --> d
  two --> d

cases.title: Two-way between groups
cases.source:
flowchart LR
  subgraph Client
    UI[Web app]
    Cache[(Local cache)]
  end
  subgraph Services
    API[API gateway] --> Orders[Order service]
    API --> Auth[Auth service]
  end
  UI --> Cache
  UI --> API
  API --> UI
  Auth -.->|token| UI
  Orders --> DB[(Orders DB)]

cases.title: Nested groups
cases.source:
flowchart TD
  subgraph outer [Outer]
    subgraph inner [Inner]
      a --> b
      b --> a
    end
    c --> a
    b --> d
  end
  start --> c
  start --> a
  d --> finish
  b --> finish
  finish --> start

cases.title: Groups with their own direction

  subgraph top [Runs down]
    direction TB
    t1 --> t2 --> t3
  end
  subgraph side [Runs across]

    s1 --> s2 --> s3
  end
  outside --> top
  outside --> s1
  t3 --> s2
  s3 --> t1
